name: Grand Hyatt San Antonio
positioning: Downtown hotel, officially named Grand Hyatt San Antonio River Walk, between the River Walk and the Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center, with a rooftop pool and themed family suites
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown base between the River Walk and the convention center
Families who want suites with separate living areas, games or a billiard table

facts.text: The hotel is positioned between the River Walk and the Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center in downtown San Antonio.
The hotel offers easy access to the Alamodome and Frost Bank Center for concerts and major events.
Rooms feature rich decor with modern Southwestern accents.
High-floor rooms have views of Hemisfair Park or the downtown skyline.
The hotel's family-friendly suites offer separate living areas and city views of downtown San Antonio.
Grand Club access rooms include complimentary daily continental breakfast in the private lounge.
The fitness and recreation deck features a lap pool, sun deck and seasonal pool bar.
The fitness center has Life Fitness cardio and strength equipment and views over San Antonio.
Moda Fare is the hotel's Italian-inspired signature restaurant, serving breakfast, lunch, dinner and cocktails inside or on its patio.
Tejas Lounge is a Texas-inspired lounge with mid-century modern design and a curated cocktail menu.
The hotel has 115,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor meeting venues.
The hotel has indoor and outdoor wedding venues.

highlights.text: The Entertainer Suite has a full-size billiard table and a private terrace with views of downtown San Antonio.
The Grand Club is a private lounge on the 23rd floor with panoramic views of the Tower of the Americas.
The rooftop pool offers panoramic views of the city, with lounge chairs on the sundeck.
The Gamer Suite has two private arcade machines.
The Wellbeing Suite is equipped with a Peloton bike, weight sets and a yoga mat.

considerations.text: The hotel's underground parking garage cannot accommodate oversize vehicles, toppers or trailers.
The hotel is dog-friendly, but dog-friendly rooms are limited and require at least 48 hours' notice.
WhataHotel notes a busy downtown location with urban noise.
